parsed.name: SPEC服务器客户端
parsed.description: 一个非物理的软件客户端组件，用于连接实验站计算机上的 SPEC 服务器，并向其发送实验控制命令。它可执行通用命令、切换工作目录、创建目录，以及访问 SPEC 中的变量、电机和计数器对象，常用于束线或实验自动化流程与 SPEC 控制环境之间的集成。
parsed.description_en: A non-physical software client component used to connect to a SPEC server on an experimental workstation and send control commands to it. It can execute general commands, change working directories, create directories, and access variables, motors, and counters inside SPEC, making it useful for integrating beamline or lab automation workflows with a SPEC control environment.

actions.description: 在 SPEC 服务器上执行命令。
actions.description_en: Execute a command on the SPEC server.

actions.description_en: Get a variable or variable object from SPEC.
